configuration.scope: bounded finite-bath physical check of exact mean-force limit and derived weak-coupling joint path

artifacts.caption: Single-oscillator spin-boson control, H=omega_q sigma_z/2+omega_b b†b+g sigma_x(b+b†), omega_b/omega_q=1.7. (a) Physical reduced-spin Bloch radius approaches the traced ground-state radius (dotted), which remains below one at nonzero coupling. (b) The dimensionless mean-force gap beta Delta_MF approaches the ground-state log eigenvalue ratio (dotted), so Delta_MF itself vanishes as temperature while retaining a mixed reduced ground state. (c) Weak-coupling excited-spin weight approaches g²/(omega_q+omega_b)² (dashed). (d) Along g(beta)=kappa(omega_q+omega_b) exp(-beta omega_q/2), the scaled excited weight approaches1+kappa² (dotted). Independent diagonalization at two oscillator cutoffs checks truncation for this finite-bath control; no continuum or generic exact spin-boson solution is claimed.

limitations: Single harmonic mode at finite, converged oscillator cutoff; not the continuum bath.
Weak-coupling and matched low-temperature expressions are asymptotic, not a generic all-coupling solution.
Lorentz identity is a known matrix correspondence checked here in the thermal filter; it does not establish gravitational field equations.
